hypotheses.justification: `universalGSpace G` is an abbreviation for `(indexedJoin fun _ : ℕ => G).Realization` (CountableJoin.lean:41). `Realization K` is the space of the standard geometric complex in `ι →₀ ℝ` with ι = Σ _ : ℕ, G. For every complex K and every point x, `AbstractSimplicialComplex.Realization.sum_eq_one` (Realization/Basic.lean:386) gives `x.1.sum (fun _ r => r) = 1`. If G were empty, Σ _ : ℕ, G would be empty, so x.1 = 0 (Finsupp on an empty type is a subsingleton) and its coordinates would sum to 0, giving 0 = 1. So the point `x` in the statement already forces `Nonempty G` (equivalently, the support of x.1 is nonempty and contains some vertex ⟨i, g⟩). When G is empty the space has no points and the statement is vacuous. New proof: `haveI : Nonempty G := by by_contra h; rw [not_nonempty_iff] at h; have := AbstractSimplicialComplex.Realization.sum_eq_one _ x; simp [Subsingleton.elim x.1 0] at this`, then the existing term `subsingleton_homotopyGroup_realization_indexedJoin (Set.infinite_univ.mono fun _ _ => ‹Nonempty G›) (Fin (n + 1)) x`. Nothing else in the statement depends on `[Nonempty G]`.
